text:
Taylor: Starting a compact follow-up for last night's KV OOMs. Root suspicion: KV-slot churn creating lots of tiny allocs + heap fragmentation. Need owners, short ETAs, and safe canary plans.
Maya: I'll own profiling + artifacts (flamegraphs + heap snapshots). ETA: Tue EOD.
Samir: I'll own eviction-policy trials and a minimal dashboard showing evictions/sec, resident_bytes, and miss-latency p50/p95. ETA: Thu COB.
Eli: I'll try allocator tweaks (jemalloc purge cadence, arena tuning) and a 5% canary for background compaction. ETA: Mon AM.
Taylor: Concrete micro-tasks:
  - Maya: run deterministic heap snapshots on the 1h replay (tools/replay.py), produce `alloc.svg` and a 2-line summary.
  - Samir: run segmented vs LRU vs TTL eviction on stg-gpu-1, measure hit-rate and tail latency.
  - Eli: enable `background_purge:60s` on canary, capture CPU delta and p99 latency.
  - infra-bot: open tracking tickets and attach last-night OOM logs + the replay trace.
infra-bot: Created tickets INF-4321 (alloc-profiling), INF-4322 (eviction-trials), INF-4323 (allocator-canary). Links: https://jira.redwood/INF-4321, https://jira.redwood/INF-4322, https://jira.redwood/INF-4323
oncall: Ops note: when running heavy replays set temporary OOM alert windows so we don't wake the whole SRE team.
Maya: Command plan: `python tools/replay.py --trace traces/repro-03-22 --duration 3600 --out=alloc.trace` then `heapdump --pid $PID --out=heap.snap` and `flamegraph.pl alloc.fold > alloc.svg`. Will attach assets to INF-4321.
Samir: Eviction knobs I'll try first: `segment_bytes=65536 max_fill=0.8` then `segment_bytes=32768 max_fill=0.6`. Will also try a small hotset pin (5%) if miss latency spikes.
Eli: To capture fragmentation: `jeprof --text /tmp/prof.heap > jemalloc.txt` and `cat /proc/$PID/smaps | grep -i rss` after runs. Canary will be 5% traffic on canary cluster with quick rollback.
Taylor: Please add a 1-line progress update to the ticket each day: e.g., "progress: flamegraph collected". Goal: have conservative mitigations ready for rollout or escalation by Apr 12.
Maya: Ack. Uploading initial flamegraph later today.
Samir: Starting eviction runs in 40m on staging, will post graphs.
Eli: Will deploy jemalloc canary tomorrow AM and monitor 1h of traffic.
Taylor: Scheduling weekly 30m sync Thu 09:00 PST x3 for status, will invite owners. If anyone hits a blocker, post here and tag me.
infra-bot: Calendar invite "KV frag triage" created Thu 09:00 PST (3 occurrences). Reminder 15m prior.
oncall: I'll add a temporary throttle on staging during noisy runs.
Maya: Note that sampling profilers undercount very short-lived small allocs; I'll include full snapshots where feasible.
Samir: If eviction reduces resident but causes miss spikes, we iterate to hybrid hotset pin + smaller segments.
Eli: If compaction costs too much CPU, we can stagger compaction windows or reduce canary % and test adaptive thresholds.
Taylor: Thanks all. Quick checklist: reproduce fragmentation pattern reliably, validate mitigations don't regress latency, and land conservative fixes or escalate by Apr 12.
